Class CardManagerController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.view.gui.CardManagerController
public class CardManagerController extends Object
Controller for managing card display and player interactions during card resolution phases. Handles the display of card information, player commands, dice results, and manages the state transitions between active player turns and spectator mode.

      public void showDiceResult(int result)
